tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Lecture Lab AI profile: display name, email and role (teacher or student).

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List uploaded lecture materials
tools.description: List the lecture materials the signed-in user uploaded to Lecture Lab AI, including the topics extracted from each document.

tools.name: list_saved_activities
tools.title: List saved activities
tools.description: List classroom activities the signed-in user generated in Lecture Lab AI (MCQs, flashcards, debates, etc.), newest first. Optionally filter by topic or activity type.

activityType.description: Filter by activity mode, e.g. mcqs, flashcards, debates, socraticQuestions.

includeContent.description: When true, include the full generated activity JSON (can be large).

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.title: List my quizzes
tools.description: List quizzes created by the signed-in user, newest first. Returns id, title, topic, share code, question count, difficulty, time limit and whether it is a practice quiz.

practiceOnly.description: When true, return only self-practice quizzes.

limit.description: Maximum number of quizzes to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_quiz
tools.title: Get a quiz
tools.description: Get one quiz with its full question list, by quiz id or by share code. Only quizzes the signed-in user can access are returned.

shareCode.description: The quiz share code, e.g. ABC123.

tools.name: list_quiz_attempts
tools.title: List quiz attempts
tools.description: List student attempts for a quiz: score, time taken, completion state and number of suspicious tab-switch events. Teachers see attempts on their own quizzes; students see their own attempts.

quizId.description: The quiz UUID to list attempts for.
